basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 24-year-old from Cagayan de Oro, currently working as a customer service representative. I recently moved to the city and I'm eager to make new friends and explore my surroundings. I'm interested in online gaming, particularly BGMI, and enjoy watching car-related content, especially about Tacoma trucks. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends discovering new cafes and hangout spots.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a good understanding of online gaming communities and customer service practices due to my job and personal interests. I learned gaming strategies through YouTube tutorials and forums, while my job has provided me with strong communication skills.
